verdict.rationale: Extend's docs mention detecting images/tables/handwriting and 'Citations' (implying traceability to source), plus a metadata object on parse output, but there is no explicit documentation of VLM-generated figure/chart summaries or image crops with page-position coordinates. missing for 10: explicit VLM summarization of figures/charts, image crop extraction, bounding-box/page-position metadata for visual elements, and independent confirmation.
